test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: By selling a calculator for Rs. 1,080, there is a loss of 10%, if the article is sold for Rs. 1,350, the net result in the transaction is:
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price (SP) of calculator = ₹1,080

Loss percentage = 10%

Selling price (SP) when sold for profit = ₹1,350

**Formula used:**

Cost Price (CP) = SP / (1 - Loss%)

Profit Percentage = ((Selling Price - Cost Price) / Cost Price) × 100

**Calculation:**

Loss% = 10%</p&
